site.name: A.P.T. Tunnel Mine
overview: A.P.T. Tunnel Mine is a documented historic mine-and-tunnel locality in Clear Creek County. USGS topographic mapping preserves the named feature near 39.77693, -105.68667, providing a defensible identification anchor without implying that a portal has been field-verified or remains accessible today.
